content.description:
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Raw Color Palette @ID: #00-01-01
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| This file contains the raw color options for the design system.
| These variables represent the "what we have" and should rarely
| be used directly in components.
|

content.cssRule:
/*== Color Assignments ==*/
--color-primary: #2476ff
--color-primary-light: #5e9aff
--color-primary-dark: #0965ff
--color-primary-rgb: 36, 118, 255
--color-secondary: #747474
--color-secondary-light: #333
--color-secondary-dark: #292929
--color-secondary-rgb: 116, 116, 116
--color-tertiary: #f97316
--color-tertiary-light: #ffa261
--color-tertiary-dark: #c95300
--color-tertiary-rgb: 249, 115, 22
--color-almost-black: #333
--color-almost-white: #fcfcfc
--color-success: #009112
--color-success-light: #98ff98
--color-success-rgb: 0, 145, 18
--color-warning: #ff9017
--color-warning-light: #ffead5
--color-warning-rgb: 255, 144, 23
--color-error: #fa3434
--color-error-light: #fdd0d0
--color-error-rgb: 250, 52, 52
/*== Text Colors ==*/
--color-text-base: #333
--color-text-alt: #fff
/*== Background Colors ==*/
--color-bg: #eee
--color-bg-alt: #222
--bg-primary: linear-gradient(0deg, #0965ff 0%, #2476ff 100%)
--bg-secondary: linear-gradient(0deg, #292929 0%, #747474 100%)
--bg-tertiary: linear-gradient(0deg, #bbb 0%, #fff 100%)
--color-border: var(--gray-200)
--color-border-hover: var(--gray-300)
/*== Gradients ==*/
--bg-gradient-1: linear-gradient(0deg, #2476ff 0%, #5e9aff 100%)
--bg-gradient-2: linear-gradient(0deg, #fff 0%, #5e9aff 100%)
--bg-gradient-3: linear-gradient(0deg, #0965ff 0%, #2476ff 100%)
--bg-gradient-4: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(94, 154, 255, 1) 0%,
    rgba(36, 118, 255, 1) 50%,
    rgba(0, 90, 238, 1) 100%
  )
--bg-gradient-5: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(94, 154, 255, 1) 0%,
    rgba(36, 118, 255, 1) 100%
  )
--bg-gradient-6: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(238, 238, 238, 1) 0%,
    rgba(193, 216, 255, 1) 100%
  )
--bg-gradient-7: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    #2476ff,
    #5e9aff 20px,
    #fff 20px,
    #ccc 32px
  )
--bg-gradient-8: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    #5e9aff,
    #0965ff 20px,
    #000 20px,
    #444 32px
  )
/*== Borders ==*/
--border: 2px solid #2476ff
--border-light: 2px solid #5e9aff
--border-dark: 2px solid #0965ff
/*== Shadows ==*/
--shadow-s: 0 1px 2px 0 hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.05)
/* Subtle */
--shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.1)
/* Medium */
--shadow-l: 0 10px 15px -3px hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.1)
/* Large */
--shadow-inner: inset 0 2px 4px 0 hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.05)
/* Inner */
